content: I'm currently at the Bridging Lean and the LMFDB workshop, and there's work being done on linking LMFDB knowls and Mathlib (see e.g. this entry added by @Chris Birkbeck). Recently there was a wikidata attribute that was set up for connecting Mathlib declarations to wikidata entries - would people think it's reasonable so have something similar for LMFDB knowl entries?
@[wikidata] is built on a reusable framework, so it should be very easy to setup

We'd also like a converse of what is currently done. At the moment, there are some items in the mathlib docs that are tagged with a wikidata identifier (e.g. AddMonoidHom is Q868169). For a lot of applications, you'd like to have a persistent link that can survive mathlib refactoring; something like https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/wikidata_links/Q868169 that redirects to https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Hom/Defs.html#AddMonoidHom.

From the LMFDB perspective, these would be really nice because then we can get persistent links into the mathlib docs.

The crossref-exports repo will contain an automatically-updated index of all declarations tagged with the wikidata, stacks or kerodon tags (after #40701 is merged, reviews welcome!). I think we should be able to set up some automation to automatically generate / update redirects to the docs using that data.

edit: Given the thumbs-up on this message, Ive added this to my list.
Happy to help review #40701 - would be great to get that merged!
OK, I've created crossref-exports#1 which copies the doc-gen4 setup so that /crossref-exports/?db=<db>&id=<id>#doc will redirect to mathlib4_docs/find?<decl>#doc (and similarly for #src).
Awesome! Once this is live, we can update the LMFDB links to use it.

I've been working on several tools to help add @[wikidata] tags to Mathlib, including a reviewer web UI and an scheduled github action that opens/manages PRs. Please let me know if you're interested in re-using any of this infrastructure for the LMFDB.

Nice. I played around with the reviewer UI a bit; is your idea that there would be a similar site for LMFDB/Lean, or that you would modify this one to allow for different kinds of crossref reviews? Also, how do people who want to do reviews log into your site so that their github username appears next to the review?

For now, there is an option to "Copy review" which you can then manually paste as a comment on Github. (It will paste the whole batch in one go.)
Alternatively, there is a button in the bottom right to "Connect GitHub to post".
That sounds super useful! I'll have a go at implementing a @[lmfdb] tag today using the @[wikidata] infrastructure that's already there.

David Roe said:

is your idea that there would be a similar site for LMFDB/Lean, or that you would modify this one to allow for different kinds of crossref reviews?

"one that allows for all different kind of crossref reviews" would be ideal. I'd want something similar to the mix'n'match review tool that exists in the wikidata ecosystem. There is already a catalogue for the LMFDB there, and it works well for quickly adding property tags.

Paul Lezeau said:

That sounds super useful! I'll have a go at implementing a @[lmfdb] tag today using the @[wikidata] infrastructure that's already there.

Done here: #41290 - reviews welcome:)

#40701 and crossref-exports#1 are now merged (thanks Kim Morrison!) so URLs like the following now take you to the appropriate doc / src pages (or a disambiguation page in case there are to_additive variants):

  • https://leanprover-community.github.io/crossref-exports/?db=wikidata&id=Q288465#doc
  • https://leanprover-community.github.io/crossref-exports/?db=stacks&id=05GG#src
  • https://leanprover-community.github.io/crossref-exports/?db=kerodon&id=009Q#doc

After #41290 gets fixed and merged, something similar should work with db=lmfdb as well.

Question: what should the zulip linkifiers for these be? Right now I'm thinking wikidata-doc#Q288465, stacks-src#05GG, kerodon-doc#009Q, etc.
